notes.title: 11-23Update
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen friends, this is the updated log of the Valkyrie:
1. We fixed the following unattainable achievements: Monopoly 2, 3, 4 and Fashion 2, 3, 4
2. Fixed the wrong wearing problem of demon wing props
3. Fixed the problem that the angel wings could not be unlocked at 100 levels
4. Optimized the story in the game and DLC dubbing

notes.title: "Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie" is now AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
"Valhalla：Awakening of Valkyrie" is now AVAILABLE, a match-3 game where players play as Odin and face Ragnarok with their Valkyries.
There are 6 Valkyries in the game that can be conquered, and dozens of levels to challenge

If you have any questions during the game, you can join our Discord channel for consultation.
